def _add_details(self, info):
        """Override the base behavior to add Nodes, VirtualIPs, etc."""
        super(Pool, self)._add_details(info)
        self.members = [Member(member) for member in info.get('members', [])]
        self.health_monitors = [
            HealthMonitor(health_monitor)
            for health_monitor in info.get('health_monitors', [])]
        self.health_monitors_status = info.get('health_monitors_status', [])
        self.session_persistence = info.get('session_persistence', [])
        self.loadbalancer_id = info.get('loadbalancer_id')
        self.listener_id = info.get('listener_id')
        self.protocol = info.get('protocol')
        self.lb_algorithm = info.get('lb_algorithm')
        self.description = info.get('description')
        self.created_at = info.get('created_at')
        self.updated_at = info.get('updated_at')
        self.provisioning_status = info.get('provisioning_status')
        self.operating_status = info.get('operating_status')
        self.enabled = info.get('enabled')
        self.name = info.get('name')
        self.project_id = info.get('project_id')
        self.vip_subnet_id = info.get('vip_subnet_id')
        self.vip_address = info.get('vip_address')
        self.vip_port_id = info.get('vip_port_id')
        self.loadbalancer_pool_id = info.get('loadbalancer_pool_id')
        self.vip_network_id = info.get('vip_network_id')
        self.vip_qos_policy_id = info.get('vip_qos_policy_id')
        self.vip_port_qos_policy_id = info.get('vip_port_qos_policy_id')
